title: Find Duplicate Records Across Columns
code:
SELECT email, COUNT(*)
FROM users
GROUP BY email
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY count DESC;
explanation: Aggregates rows grouped by a unique column (e.g. email or username) and filters with HAVING to display only values that occur more than once.
tip: Use a CTE with `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email ORDER BY created_at)` if you need to selectively delete the older duplicates.
